spans.s:
mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Going with trouble or difficulty.
2 Acting ill, behaving wickedly.
3 Unattainable.
m. (-रः)
1 A bivalve shell.
2 A bear.
E.
दुर् bad, चर to go, अच् or टच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Misbehaving, abandoned, wicked.
m. (-तं)
Misbehaviour, ill conduct, wickedness.
E.
दुर्, and चरित conduct.

m. (-र्म्मा)
A circumcised man, or one whose prepuce is naturally or artificially wanting.
E.
दुर् bad, difficult, चर्म्मन् skin.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Misbehaving, doing or designing evil.
n. (-तं)
Evil purpose or action, misconduct, error.
E.
दुर्, and चेष्टित exerted.

m. (-नः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
दुर् ill, च्यवन the name of a saint: INDRA having raised his arm to hurl his thunderbolt at Cyavana, had it fixed in that position by the curse of the saint; other etymologies are given.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Tattered, hardly covered.
E.
दुर्, and छद covering.

m. (-नः)
One of the Kaurava princes.
E.
दुर्, and शासन government.

(इर, जौ) इरदुषौ r. 4th cl. (दुष्यति)
1 To do or act wrong or improperly.
2 To be impure.
With प्र and आङ् prefixed,
To become manifest or apparent.

r. 4th cl. (दूष्यति)
1 To be or become bad.
2 To make bad.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Difficult to be done.
2 One who behaves ill, does wrong, &c. wicked, bad.
n. (-रं)
1 Æther, atmosphere.
2 The tree of plenty.
3 Doing any thing with pain or difficulty.
E.
दुर् bad, and कर what does, from कृ with खल् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 Wickedness, sin.
2 Any difficult or painful act.
E.
दुर्, and कर्म्मन् act.

n. (-लं)
A low family or race.
E.
दुर् bad, कुल race.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Of a low or degraded family.
m. (-नः)
A sort of perfume, commonly Chor.
E.
दुर् bad, कुलीन family or species.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Done wrong or wickedly.
2 Done with difficulty or pain.
n. (-तं)
Sin, crime, guilt.
E.
दुर् evil, कृत done, committed.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Wicked, reprobate.
n. (-र्म्म)
Wickedness.
E.
दुष्कृत, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Holy, free from sin.
E.
दुष्कृत, and वहिष्कृत excluded.

mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति)
Wicked, an evil doer.
E.
दुष्कृत, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Difficult of access.
2 Going ill or laboriously.
3 Ill arranged, unmethodical.
E.
दुर्, and क्रम going.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dear, bought too dearly or unadvisedly.
E.
दुर् bad, क्रीत purchased: a bad bargain.

n. (-ष्खं)
Pain in general: see दुःख.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Low, vile.
2 Weak, impotent.
3 Wicked, depraved.
4 Spoiled, injured.
5

Violated.
6

Contaminated, degraded.
7 Worthless.
f. (-ष्टा)
A harlot, a wanton.
n. (-ष्टं)
A kind of Costus, (C. speciosus): see कुष्ट.
E.
दुष to be corrupt, &c. affix क्त.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Wicked.
E.
दुष्ट, and चारिन् practising.

Malevolent.
2

Stupid.
E.
दुष्ट, and चेतस् the heart or mind.

f. (-ता)
1 Wickedness, badness.
2 Contamination, defilement.
3 Violation.
E.
तल् added to दुष्ट; also त्व, दुष्टत्वं.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Innately bad.
E.
दुष्ट, and भाव nature.

f. (-ता)
Wickedness, innate depravity.
E.
दुष्टभाव, and तल् aff.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Wicked, depraved.
E.
दुष्ट, and मति mind.

m. (-षः)
A lazy ox.
E.
दुष्ट as above, and वृष an ox.

m. (-णः)
A dull boil or sore, a sinus.
E.
दुष्ट bad, and व्रण sore.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Defiled, rendered impure.
E.
दुष्ट, and possessed of.

ind.
1 Ill, bad.
2 Improperly, incorrectly.
mfn. (-ष्ठुः-ष्ठुः-ष्ठु)
Ill behaved, unprincipled, depraved.
E.
दु ill, स्था to be, affix कु.

m. (-त्रः)
Cor, a perfume.
E.
दुर् bad, पत्र a leaf.

mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं)
Not to be touched, unpleasant to the touch.
m. (-र्शः)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji): see दुःस्पर्श.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Difficult to be drank.
E.
दुर्, and पान drinking.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Of a bad nature or disposition.
E.
दुर्, and प्रकृति nature.

f. (-णी)
The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
दुर् with difficulty, प्र before धृष to show, to guide, affix ल्युट्; also with णिनि affix दुष्प्रधर्षिणी.

f. (-र्षा)
A plant, (Hedysarium alhaji.)
2 The date tree.
E.
दुर्, and प्र before धृष to guide, affix अङ्, and टाप्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Immeasurable, difficult to be measured.
E.
दुर्, and प्र before मी to measure, खल् aff.

mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं)
Difficult of attainment.
E.
दुर्, and प्र before लभ to gain, खल् affix, नुम् inserted.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Difficult of attainment, difficult to be got or reached.
E.
दुर्, and प्राप obtaining.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
Remote, unattainable, difficult of approach or attainment.
E.
दुर्, and प्राप्य obtainable.

m. (-न्तः)
A prince of the lunar line, the husband of ŚAKUNTALĀ.
E.
दुर्, and झ affix, मुम् aug.; also read दुष्यन्त.

m. (-न्तः)
A prince: see the last.
E.
दुष to do wrong, झ aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Difficult to be crossed.
E.
दुर्, and तर crossing.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Difficult to be relinquished or parted with.
E.
दुर्, and त्यज abandoning.

m. (-थः)
1 A dog.
2 A cock.

n. (-श्यं)
A tent: see दूष्य.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
Reprehensible, contemptible, vile, bad.
f. (-ष्या)
An elephant's leathern girth.
n. (-ष्यं)
1

Clothes.
2

A tent.
3 Pus, matter.
E.
दूष to be or become wicked or bad, यत् or ण्यत् affix, fem. affix टाप्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Ill, low, contemptible, infamous.
2 Spoiling, corrupting, contaminating, who or what does so.
E.
दूष to be vile, affix क.

m. (-णः)
A Rākṣasa, the brother of RĀVAṆA.
n. (-णं)
1 Blame, fault, defect, offence.
2 Spoiling, ruining, vitiating, defiling.
3 Violating, (as a girl.)
4 Breaking, (as an agreement.)
E.
दूष to become vile or wicked, affix युच्.

m. (-रिः)
RĀMA.
E.
दूषण the brother of RĀVAṆA, and अरि a foe.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Vitiating, defiling, spoiling.
E.
दूष to make bad, शानच् aff.

f. (-षिः-षी)
The rheum of the eyes.
E.
दूष to make bad, affix कि or क with डीष् added; also दूषिका and दूषीका.

f. (-का)
1 The rheum of the eyes.
2 A pencil or painting brush.
E.
दूष to make bad, (the eyes, &c.) affix ण्वुल्, fem. form; also दूषी, दूषि, and दूषीका.

f. (-का)
The secretion or rheum of the eyes.
E.
दूष to hurt, (the eyes,) Uṇādi affix ईकन्: see दूषिका.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Calumniated, falsely accused, especially of adultery.
2 Contaminated, corrupted, spoiled.
3

Violated.
4

Blamed, censured.
f. (-ता)
A girl who has been violated or deflowered.
E.
दूष to become or make bad, affix क्त.

n. (-षं)
Poison that may be overcome by drugs or charms, or that does not act upon the system.
E.
दूषी rheum, and विष venom.
